notes: Todo Detail worklist previously rendered the Müşteri Kartını Aç action whenever the navigation callback existed, even when the current user lacked fair_crm.customers.read. The action now fails closed in the UI and is offered only when customer read permission is granted. Todo worklist access itself remains governed by Todo permissions.
